title: Domains
description: Marks email and web domains as managed, so documents from them open only in managed apps and Safari warns about unmanaged email addresses.

CrossSiteTrackingPreventionRelaxedApps.title: Cross-site tracking prevention relaxed apps
CrossSiteTrackingPreventionRelaxedApps.description: An array of up to 10 strings representing app bundle-ids. Apps matching the bundle-ids listed here have relaxed enforcement of cross-site tracking prevention for the domains listed in CrossSiteTrackingPreventionRelaxedDomains.

CrossSiteTrackingPreventionRelaxedDomain.title: Cross-site tracking prevention relaxed domains
CrossSiteTrackingPreventionRelaxedDomain.description: An array of up to 10 strings. URLs matching the patterns listed here have relaxed enforcement of cross-site tracking prevention.

EmailDomains.title: Email domains
EmailDomains.description: An array of domains. Mail marks in red all email addresses that lack a suffix matching any of these strings.
